headline: WSN @ CIN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is WSN 4.46 at CIN 4.21, with a projected total of 8.67. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CIN: WSN moved -0.91 runs while CIN moved -0.49, changing the projected margin by -0.42 runs. The projected total fell -1.39, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -18.3%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Jake Irvin has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 2.4 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Elly De La Cruz, JJ Bleday, Daylen Lile, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Will Benson because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
